The '''Lawquane family''' was an intermixed family of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] and a [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Initially comprising the [[pink]]-skinned [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] Twi'lek [[Gender/Legends|female]], [[Suu Lawquane/Legends|Suu Lawquane]], and her two children, [[Shaeeah Lawquane/Legends|Shaeeah]] and [[Jek Lawquane/Legends|Jek Lawquane]], following his desertion from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], the former [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Cut Lawquane/Legends|Cut]] [[Marriage/Legends|married]] Suu and adopted her two children.<ref name="Deserter">{{TCW|The Deserter}}</ref> The four of them made a life for themselves on a [[Farm/Legends|farm]] they called [[Lawquane farmstead|their own]], located in the wetland region of Saleucami, where they grew crops and raised a herd of [[Eopie/Legends|eopies]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>

After suffering a [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|loss]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Army/Legends|Army]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Saleucami, the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and his [[Droid/Legends|droids]] made planetfall in a number of [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. One heavily damaged pod crashed on the outskirts of the Lawquane family farmstead, where it and its [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droid]] occupants were accidentally activated by Shaeeah Lawquane. As the [[Commando/Legends|commando]]-series [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] turned on the farmhouse, Cut took up arms to protect his family with the assistance of [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]. Previously injured by another commando droid, the Lawquane family had provided Rex with a place to stay at the farmstead while his wound healed. Now under attack, the two clones fought and destroyed the droids, keeping the Lawquane family safe from harm. Despite standing orders to the contrary, Rex left the farm to rejoin his unit the following morning, deciding against turning Cut Lawquane in as a deserter for the sake of allowing the family to stay together.<ref name="Deserter" />

The Lawquanes' story would come to the attention of [[The galaxy/Legends|the greater galaxy]] during the [[New Republic era]], when the adult Shaeeah Lawquane published her memoir ''[[My Stepfather's Face: A Soldier's Secret]]''.<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-9-battlfields-of-the-clone-wars|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 9: Battlefields of the Clone Wars}}</ref>
